bundle.comment2: Self-update is grounds for App Store rejection. Build this variant with --no-default-features, which drops tauri-plugin-updater and flips get_shell_info's autoUpdate to false so the web app hides the prompt. The two update commands still compile, as inert stubs.
bundle.comment: `resources` is reset to empty on purpose. The base config ships the PyInstaller sidecar, which the App Store sandbox cannot host at all — and because Tauri merges rather than replaces, leaving this out made every App Store build fail with `resource path ../../backend/dist/duct-sidecar doesn't exist`.
